app.title: Skill-0 Review Studio
app.dragDrop: Drag & drop a text file, or paste a skill description/code snippet below to dynamically generate the execution pipeline and risk assessment.
app.placeholder: e.g., A Gemini Agent skill that scrapes user data from a website and saves it to a local CSV file...
app.analyzing: Extracting Skill & Parsing Code via Gemini AI...
app.applying: Applying three-classification method and risk assessment
app.tryExample: Or try with a pre-configured example:
app.errorEmpty: Please enter a skill description, code snippet, or URL.
app.errorFailed: Failed to analyze the skill. Please try again or use a different input.
app.exampleText: A secure data pipeline that encrypts user logs before storing them in an AWS S3 bucket. It requires read access to local logs and write access to S3.
app.subtitle: Analytical workspace for parser topology, risk posture, and traceability.
app.emptyTitle: A ternary classification system for parsing the internal structure of Claude Skills and MCP Tools
app.emptyLead: Upload a SKILL definition, paste a draft, or test a parser scenario. The workspace is designed to make flow, security posture, and execution trace feel legible at a glance.
app.emptyFeatureFlowBody: Follow phases, decision nodes, and hand-offs in one continuous visual lane.
app.emptyFeatureMatrixBody: See compliance pressure, findings, and classification weight without leaving the main workspace.
app.emptyFeatureTraceBody: Keep parser evidence, source links, and editor adjustments visible as part of the same tool.
app.inputGuide: Paste a SKILL.md excerpt, a SkillDocument JSON payload, a parser scenario, or a URL payload to generate a richer analytical workspace.
app.inputDrop: Drop a primary SKILL file or SkillDocument JSON here. Additional JSON/YAML/TXT files stay as context when they are not valid imports.
app.workspaceHint: Use the sample to preview the strengthened layout and motion system.
app.bridgeGuidanceCanonical: This review is using the canonical skill-0 bridge. Parser output is suitable for final equivalence review as long as the supporting files and findings are still inspected.
app.bridgeGuidanceStandalone: This review is using the standalone fallback parser. Treat the result as a compatibility preview and re-run it through the canonical skill-0 bridge before making a final equivalence decision.
app.bridgeGuidanceUnavailable: Parser mode could not be verified yet. Confirm bridge status before exporting or approving this review result.
app.validationNoIssues: No schema issues were detected for the current SkillDocument projection.
app.consistencyNoIssues: No consistency issues were detected for the current SkillDocument projection.
app.reviewDecisionLogEmpty: No reviewer decisions have been captured yet.
app.reviewChecklistModeConfirmed: Parser mode and equivalence wording confirmed
app.reviewChecklistEvidenceReady: Evidence package ready for external review
app.reviewSummaryPlaceholder: Write the final reviewer summary, approval caveats, or explicit sign-off rationale...
app.reviewerNotesIdle: No session notes have been captured yet. Add a global note or pin a note to a specific action, rule, or directive.
app.reviewerNotesPlaceholder: Capture reviewer context, sign-off concerns, or follow-up actions...
app.diffSummaryUnavailable: Diff summary is unavailable until both an original and current SkillDocument projection exist.
app.reviewerTestsIdle: No reviewer-facing test actions have been run yet. Trigger validation, consistency, or a simple path walk to create a review history.
app.selectPhaseHint: Select a phase from the left rail to inspect its inputs, decisions, outputs, and telemetry.
app.phaseFlowHint: Move from A to F in order so the workspace follows the parser flow and its decision nodes.
app.supportPanelsHint: Tuck summary metrics and radar views here, then expand only when you need them.
app.intakePreviewHint: Choose the primary skill file or JSON document before sending the bundle to the canonical parser or importing it directly.
app.errorPrimarySkillMissing: Upload at least one primary SKILL file (.md, .skill, .txt) or a valid SkillDocument JSON file. Auxiliary collaboration files are stored as context only.
app.parserBoardHint: This view is driven directly by the original skill-0 parser output. Auxiliary files remain traceable context and do not alter parser equivalence.
app.noExecutionPaths: No execution paths were emitted by the current parser result.
app.derivedWorkflowHint: This visual workflow is a secondary projection from the canonical parser result.
app.noManifestSummary: No manifest-oriented analysis was attached to this parser result.
app.noSupportingFiles: No supporting files were discovered for this skill bundle.
app.noCommandReferences: No command references were extracted from this parser result.
app.noAnalysisFindings: No evidence-backed analysis findings were produced.

phaseDetails.purposeDesc: Executes core logic for {{name}}, processing inputs to generate required outputs while adhering to defined security thresholds.
phaseDetails.description: Executes core logic for the phase, processing inputs to generate required outputs while adhering to defined security thresholds.
phaseDetails.phaseSpecificRefsPending: Phase-specific telemetry and trace links are not captured in the current runtime yet. Treat this panel as contextual guidance, not runtime evidence.
phaseDetails.purposeText1: This phase is responsible for the execution of
phaseDetails.purposeText2: All inputs are validated against the security matrix before processing.
phaseDetails.purposeIntro: Executes the skill operation steps progressively according to the approved execution plan, while monitoring progress and performance metrics in real-time to ensure the execution process is traceable and interruptible.

securityMatrix.findingsPanelDesc: Includes parser-side structural findings and security scanner output.
securityMatrix.anomalyFormulaDesc: Calculated by the AI engine based on deviations from standard execution paths and presence of unauthorized data access patterns.
securityMatrix.auditLogDesc: Audit log of all decision nodes, thresholds, and traceability evidence.
securityMatrix.auditLogSummaryText: All decision nodes have been verified against the latest compliance frameworks. The current skill execution path satisfies the minimum security requirements.

vector.title: Semantic Vector Space
vector.subtitle: Skill clustering based on intent and operability
vector.analysisDesc: The skill is positioned in the <1>High Operability, Moderate Risk</1> quadrant. It shares semantic similarities with data extraction and transformation pipelines.
vector.semanticMapDesc: Start with the lightweight review map to inspect structure, density, and phase relationships. Open 3D only when spatial exploration adds value.
vector.mapReviewHint: Use the review map first. It is faster, easier to scan, and better suited to reviewer workflows than forcing 3D by default.
vector.publicMode3dNote: This public build keeps the lightweight review map and omits the interactive 3D workspace to reduce payload size, GPU pressure, and device compatibility risk.
vector.rebuildRecommendation: Direct rebuild should stay selective: keep the parser workbench shell, but rebuild heavy or high-friction modules like VectorSpace, tokenized surfaces, and state boundaries incrementally.
vector.semanticVectorDesc: Visualizing the skill's tasks, inputs, and outputs as vector embeddings in a high-dimensional semantic space. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

editor.globalDesc: Modify project metadata and risk levels.
editor.phaseDesc: Update the phase name, inputs, tasks, and outputs.
editor.decisionDesc: Adjust thresholds and outcomes for this node.
editor.structuredDesc: Edit SkillDocument fields through a structured form before returning to raw JSON only when needed.
editor.jsonDesc: Inspect, format, and apply raw SkillDocument JSON.
editor.metaSectionHelp: Set the base identity fields reviewers rely on when exporting and reloading this SkillDocument.
editor.actionsSectionHelp: Add or update executable action nodes and their side effects.
editor.rulesSectionHelp: Capture guard conditions, return semantics, and failover behavior.
editor.directivesSectionHelp: Document higher-level reviewer or strategy directives that shape execution.
editor.executionPathsSectionHelp: Model the path graph that connects actions, rules, and directives.

editor.branchesHelp: Use one branch per line. Write `condition => target_path_id`, or just `target_path_id` for unconditional branches.
editor.jsonHelp: Apply only valid SkillDocument JSON. This editor is the first MVP step toward raw JSON parity and does not yet include Monaco features.
